Carries top weight well and has tactical versatility to handle the 420m Kembla climb. | 🔻 Class Drop • 📏 Sprint to Route

all_contenders.name: Brazil
all_contenders.reason: Drops back from a Tier 1 Saturday Benchmark 72 at Royal Randwick to provincial grade. Proven winner at 1600m and should appreciate the class relief despite an awkward barrier. | 🔻 Class Drop

all_contenders.name: Southerly Buster
all_contenders.reason: In career-best form over 1600m, having won the Tamworth BM82 two starts back before a brave 2nd at Newcastle BM68. Benefits from apprentice claim to offset 60.5kg physical tax and possesses sustained finishing power.

all_contenders.name: Bellevue
all_contenders.reason: Rock-solid last-start 2nd over the mile at Wyong beaten under a length. Draws ideally in gate 5 to secure cover before launching up the Kembla rise. Nicely weighted with only 56kg.

all_contenders.name: Etched In Time
all_contenders.reason: Reaches peak fitness 3rd-up and steps up to his optimal 1600m journey where he has recorded 3 career victories. Sam Clipperton picks up the mount from low barrier 4, ensuring an economical ground-saving trip. | 📏 Sprint to Route

all_contenders.name: Tavolo
all_contenders.reason: High-upside danger horse who flashed home from last to miss by just half a length over 1400m here a week ago. Steps up to 1600m and gets a low-weight luxury on a sweeping track that suits late swoopers. | 📏 Sprint to Route

contenders.handicapper_notes: Significant class drop dropping out of Saturday Metro Tier 1 3&4yo BM72 company at Randwick back to Provincial BM64 level. Won decisively over this 1000m sprint trip at Hawkesbury two starts back and boasts a proven 50% strike rate at the distance (4: 2-2-0). Guymer retains strong tactical alignment.

Superbly drawn in barrier 1 to exploit the +8m rail configuration. Boasts outstanding distance credentials with 6 wins at 1000m (18: 6-2-1) and was narrowly denied by a head over this exact track and distance last start carrying comparable weight. Will command the rail early.

Ciaron Maher trained mare bringing solid sprint figures. Placed 3rd over 900m at Newcastle after winning a Super Maiden two back. Gets prime mid-barrier position and top metropolitan jockey Sam Clipperton aboard carrying a manageable 57.5kg.

Honest provincial campaigner third-up from a spell. Finished an excellent 3rd over 1000m at Kembla Grange last outing behind Century Song with solid late sectionals. Well mapped from barrier 4 with Jeff Penza retaining the ride.

Resumes 1st-Up for Richard & Will Freedman with Lee Magorrian booked. Won nicely over 1175m when fresh last campaign and has tuned up with two solid metropolitan trials at Rosehill. Dangerous closer drawn favorably in stall 3.

Drops from Randwick Kensington BM72 grade into Provincial BM64. Has won 1st-Up previously at Hawkesbury over 1100m. Faces an awkward barrier 12 and 61.5kg top weight burden, but 3kg apprentice Deon Le Roux provides valuable weight relief.
